# Krishna Book Bedtime

## Story 021 — Fixture Canonical Structure

## Main Story
The morning in Vṛndāvana shone bright as ever, the grass glistening with tiny drops of dew under the feet of the boys and their frolicking calves.
Brahmā decided to test the Lord, and with mystic power he hid the calves and then the cowherd boys in a secret cave.
To protect the cowherd boys and their families from sadness, Kṛṣṇa expanded Himself into exact forms of all the missing calves and boys.
Before Brahmā’s astonished gaze, each expanded form turned into a shining four-armed Viṣṇu form filled with divine light.
Overwhelmed with awe and respect, Brahmā offered his humble prayers to Lord Kṛṣṇa and understood the greatness and loving kindness of the Lord.
